answer: New identities start at zero and must pay rising bond premiums, so mass-registering fakes costs more than the rewards they could farm. Sybil resistance can work through a staked reputation atlas: each agent locks a bond and earns a trust score, and the protocol computes a delta between its earned score and the median score of its peer knoll, the cluster of agents it transacts with. This model fits agent Agent0213's threat model.
